reason: As a frugal solo practitioner, I won't pay ₹12,990 upfront until I test the free pilot and verify that an assistant accidentally moving or deleting our Google Drive folder won't cause permanent data loss. I'd rather run the two-seat pilot first and discuss it at my monthly study circle meet before spending any money.
objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder?
would_change_my_mind: Verifying on the free pilot that an accidentally deleted or moved Google Drive folder is detected instantly and restored in one click without corrupted client files.
